summary: Windward Bio Group AG operates as a clinical stage biotechnology company that develops ultra-long-acting antibody medicines for patients with respiratory and dermatologic diseases. Its drug candidates WIN378, an ultra-long-acting and novel fully human monoclonal antibody, which has completed Phase I clinical study that inhibits thymic stromal lymphopoietin (TSLP); and WIN027, an ultra-long-acting bispecific antibody that is in Phase I clinical study simultaneously targets TSLP and interleukin-13 (IL-13) and two clinically validated drivers of inflammatory disease. The company has collaboration agreements with Sichuan Kelun-Biotech BioPharmaceutical Co., Ltd, Harbour BioMed (Shanghai) Co., Ltd, and Qyuns Therapeutics Co., Ltd. Windward Bio Group AG was incorporated in 2024 and is based in Basel, Switzerland.
